title: How is Adolf Hitler connected to Mario?
description:
Three boxing champions, the Terminator and Star-Lord connect Adolf Hitler to Mario.

Adolf Hitler → Max Schmeling → Joe Louis → Muhammad Ali → Arnold Schwarzenegger → Chris Pratt → Mario

How they're connected (every photo is real and sourced):
1. Adolf Hitler → Max Schmeling: In 1936, Hitler welcomed home German boxer Max Schmeling after his shock win in New York.
   Photo by International News Photos, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Anny_Ondra,_Max_Schmeling_and_Hitler_after_the_1st_fight_against_Joe_Louis.jpg
2. Max Schmeling → Joe Louis: The man he beat, Joe Louis, knocked him out in their rematch, and later they became friends.
   Photo by Associated Press, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Joe_Louis_and_Max_Schmeling_1971_Press_Photo.jpg
3. Joe Louis → Muhammad Ali: In 1965, Joe Louis dropped by the training camp of the young champ, Muhammad Ali.
   Photo by UPI, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:4_Champions_ALI_LOUIS_WALCOTT_BRADDOCK_1965_UPI_photo.jpg
4. Muhammad Ali → Arnold Schwarzenegger: In 2002, Arnold raised Ali's hand at a charity fight night.
   Photo by Jeff Topping/Getty Images, Fair use (commentary): https://biznakenya.com/boxing-legend-muhammad-ali-dies-aged-74/
5. Arnold Schwarzenegger → Chris Pratt: In 2025, at his FUBAR premiere in Los Angeles, Arnold posed with son-in-law Chris Pratt.
   Photo by Charley Gallay/Getty Images, Fair use (commentary): https://www.goodmorningamerica.com/culture/story/arnold-schwarzeneggers-family-supports-fubar-premiere-122790066
6. Chris Pratt → Mario: Chris Pratt voices Mario.
   Photo by Gage Skidmore, Nintendo / Illumination / Universal Pictures, CC BY-SA 3.0 / Fair use (commentary): https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Chris_Pratt_by_Gage_Skidmore.jpg + https://screen-connections.com/2023/03/09/the-super-mario-bros-movie-final-trailer-main-poster-6-more-character-posters/

Give me two names in the comments and I'll find the photos that connect them.

#adolfhitler #mario #sixdegrees #history #didyouknow #shorts
first_comment: Who should Hitler connect to next? Name anyone (a character works too) and I'll find the photos.
